finding.claim: The /preview endpoint fetches a fully attacker-controlled URL server-side with no validation. An attacker can reach internal services, cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), localhost, or internal hosts, and the first 500 bytes of the response body are returned to them (non-blind SSRF).

trace.note: target = request.args.get('url', '') takes the attacker-controlled query parameter
requests.get(target) is called with the raw value; redirects are followed by default
resp.text[:500] and the status code are returned to the caller

finding.guards_checked: None on this path. There is no scheme check, no host allowlist (ALLOWED_HOSTS is only used in /partner), no private/loopback IP blocking, and no auth decorator.

verdict.reason: app.py:15 reads the user-supplied `url` query parameter and app.py:16 passes it straight to requests.get(). app.py:17 returns the status code and the first 500 bytes of the body. The route has no host check (unlike /partner at app.py:23-25), no auth decorator, and no other middleware in the file.
